untrusted_delimiter_isolation.mechanism: All incident and rule data wrapped in <UNTRUSTED_INCIDENT_DATA> with strict closing tag HTML entity escaping (</UNTRUSTED_INCIDENT_DATA>)

zero_leakage_of_ground_truth.mechanism: Model-facing payload builder strips all ground_truth_label, analyst comments, and resolution fields prior to prompt assembly

preflight_telemetry_gate.mechanism: EvidencePreflightValidator verifies contract status APPROVED and mandatory field presence prior to dispatch; abstains with 0 GPU waste if critical telemetry is missing

claim_grounding_audit.mechanism: ModelClaimExtractor grounds 100% of model assertions against canonical evidence IDs; ungrounded claims rejected

shadow_mode_closure_lock.mechanism: auto_incident_closure_allowed is hardcoded to False in Shadow Mode. Autonomous incident closure is unconditionally prohibited

zero_secret_exposure.mechanism: Endpoint authorization headers and SSH keys sanitized; zero credentials exposed in artifacts or git ledgers
